description: Zero-force comparator for 244 sequential B3LYP path geometries; derived during audit, not a new historical result.
formula: Predict zero; component MAE=mean(abs(F)), component RMSE=sqrt(mean(F**2)), vector RMS=sqrt(mean(sum(F**2,axis=1))).
scope: Path-local baseline only. Frozen three-model tables remain unchanged.
